scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: npm run db:up && concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.start: npm run db:up && concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run start --prefix backend" "npm run preview --prefix frontend"
scripts.db:migrate: docker compose exec db sh -c "PGPASSWORD=postgres psql -U postgres -d simple_feedback -f /app/backend_db/schema.sql"
scripts.dev:setup: npm run db:up && npm run db:migrate
